concept: Review and integration: a personal relationship with fear and action
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across risking change, advocating for others, and admitting failure — what's your personal throughline with fear and action?
exercise.practice: Adult writes a short personal statement on what courage means to them in practice

assessment.success_marker: adult produces a personal statement referencing at least two of the three adult-stage scenarios
